observed.caption: An elevated view of a busy multi-lane urban avenue filled with buses, cars, and pedestrians under an overcast sky.
observed.description: A wide multi-lane paved avenue runs from the foreground into the distance, divided by a central median with a metal fence. Numerous buses, minibuses, cars, vans, and motorcycles occupy the lanes, with heavy traffic on the left side and lighter traffic on the right. Tall buildings line both sides, including a prominent beige high-rise with vertical dark glazing in the center background and a long brown concrete elevated pedestrian walkway on the right with people standing on its upper level. Green trees line the sidewalks, and pedestrians are visible walking on pavements on both sides and on the walkway. Billboards with text stand on the central median, and a white delivery truck is parked on the right roadside near bollards. The sky is overcast with gray-white clouds providing diffuse daylight.
